motivation: Two preserved identical-view fixtures disagree on nine-probe source admission at exact integer projections because neighboring interpolation cells have different support. Add a conservative numerical support rectangle without snapping query coordinates or changing retained residuals
data_role: Already viewed outcome-informed development, not held-out validation
support_rectangle: Project each original optical query without snapping. In each image axis compute floor(coordinate-1e-9) and floor(coordinate+1e-9). Require every cell at the four endpoint combinations to be supported. Thus an exact integer query needs both incident cells per axis, four at a corner; ordinary interior queries retain their original single cell. Endpoint floors define the convention at the engineering band's outer boundary
cell_support: Cache per prepared frame/level: original image cell bounds; four measured depths strictly0.3..5m; spread<=0.05+0.01*minimum depth; original one-sided slope support at all four vertices; finite du/dv. Missing depth/slope support stays missing. No added normals, geometry filling, new residual terms or weights
sampler: Filter queries by that support rectangle, then call the exact original one-sided Hermite sampler on original coordinates. Preserve returned residuals, projective derivatives and target points for retained queries, and map IDs back to original ordering. No coordinate rounding, extrapolation, clipping, fallback or changed polynomial. The prior bilinear geometric center selector and its historical normalizers remain unchanged
selection_and_solver: Bind the same nine-probe and source-slicing bodies to the new sampler, beginning from the same original bilinear geometric seed. Keep source point/normal values, retained metric normalizers and minimum200 per factor. Private unchanged one-sided objective/search functions and extended driver enforce one fixed population through the whole90-correction fit, without reselection. Same prior/ownership, Huber0.01m,21 Armijo candidates and slack, condition1e6, increment0.1m/0.15rad and strict1e-5m/1e-5rad convergence
independent_verification: Separate sliding-window cell construction and homogeneous projection with independently prepared one-sided fields qualify the support rectangle. Private unchanged independent polynomial sampler/objective/solver/checkpoint audit binds only new sample/selection. Retain original center selector and old control audit separately. Source proof checks private bindings and unchanged function bodies. Original PNG hashes, timestamps, axial-Z /5000 once and independent PCA/SVD surfaces remain mandatory
analytic_controls: Reproduce both historical old admission disagreements; require exact new source agreement, explicit source losses and independently verified zero-update identity convergence and30/60/90 checkpoints. Curved fields check unchanged retained values and18 finite-difference derivative components including jointly supported knots. Half/quarter-band queries near an unsupported neighbor reject on both sides; queries safely outside the band use ordinary support. A diagonal missing corner, invalid queries, moved rendered fit, missing/plane guards,12 nonzero-prior axes and four corruptions are checked
retention: The policy is conservative: no new source/factor admission relative to the old control at the same initial pose. Independently record old/new/retained/lost counts and exact retained source point/normal/normalizer parity; do not assume100% retention. Report complete equality of each new recorded report to its old control if observed, rather than requiring such an outcome
fresh_checks: Keep the original-discrete fresh equation and proposal in every report. Also reconstruct one freshly selected continuous endpoint system read-only; neither fresh check feeds back into the fixed fit
followup_numerical_progression_rule: Both cases converge all five fixed windows, improve original-discrete fresh convergence, have no local/fresh guards, pass0.03m fresh RMS gates and have median fresh RMS no worse than the original admission control. Resolving the two identity fixtures alone does not satisfy progression or establish general domain correctness
limits: The1e-9pixel band is an engineering support guard, not a certified floating-point error bound or probabilistic uncertainty. Its own outer boundary remains a finite-precision classification. Candidate domain still changes at unsupported geometry; initial finite probes do not certify whole future paths. Tests resolve the two archived cases, without a universal numerical-stability claim
scope: No refit of the failed three-round experiment, numeric real reference labels, physical trajectory score, new continuous trajectory, tracker/prior/Schur commit, native/default adoption, vehicle integration or timing claim. Preserve all historical sources and failed evidence
